description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Viscera Seer didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning Viscera Seer from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Viscera Seer from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Viscera Seer is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
